crop.notes: Crop is a run of the 'Local Gossip' column (fruit prices, milliner, hotel clerk, waiter, aurist, gripman, Dr. Maughs). Only the 'France Chandler' item (crop-4) is about Allen, and it is complete.

ocr.notes: Whole column transcribed; the Chandler item reads well apart from small slips (Alien, McOool).

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat printed France Chandler's memory of the Tom Allen-Mike McCool prize fight, held at an island below the city. He said Allen outclassed McCool, cutting him badly while taking little punishment himself.

metadata.notes: Running head: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, September 16, 1888, page 6.

facts.fact: France Chandler recalled that Allen beat Mike McCool in a prize fight on an island some distance below St. Louis, reached by river steamer; Allen took little punishment
places: island in the Mississippi below St. Louis

notes: Fight date is not given in the item; this is a later eyewitness recollection (the Allen-McCool fight of 1873). The current summary wrongly says McCool 'remained relatively unhurt'; the item says he seemed to feel little pain while being cut up.
